posts.text:
I randomly met @fullpatstack in Orneval this morning.

And… he just made his first $1 online today with his new app https://t.co/kEki052WF6 👏👏

Unfortunately some Alliance people cut our conversation short but we obliterated them. For the Horde! https://t.co/NQij19N8UK
